_metadata.description: AWS services that consume a KMS CMK and the key-policy Statement requirements AWS enforces for each. Only services explicitly verified via deploy+teardown testing are included. Unknown consumer types emit KMS-CONSUMER-UNKNOWN warnings at hook time with a pointer to this file. Add new entries only after verifying the principal + required actions against the service's own "Encrypting data with KMS for <service>" developer guide page.
sources: Each entry: the specific service's "Encrypting data with KMS for <service>" page
_metadata.verification: Every consumer below has been validated in at least one smoke-test deploy+teardown cycle
_metadata.curation: This file is hand-curated. New entries require a deploy-verified principal + required_actions per service. No automated scraper — AWS docs for KMS consumer permissions are per-service prose.

AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping.conditions_hint: StringEquals aws:SourceAccount; Lambda encrypts/decrypts the event source mapping FilterCriteria object with the customer-managed key (kms:Decrypt required to view plaintext via GetEventSourceMapping)

AWS::Lambda::CapacityProvider.conditions_hint: StringEquals aws:SourceAccount; the Lambda service principal encrypts the capacity provider's resources with the customer-managed key referenced by KmsKeyArn (same key-policy grant pattern Lambda requires for customer-managed-key encryption: kms:GenerateDataKey + kms:Decrypt for lambda.amazonaws.com). Ref: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/encrypt-zip-package.html

AWS::ECS::Cluster.conditions_hint: StringEquals aws:SourceAccount; Fargate ephemeral storage uses fargate.amazonaws.com with kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + kms:CreateGrant and aws:ecs:clusterAccount/clusterName encryption-context keys

AWS::EFS::FileSystem.conditions_hint: StringEquals aws:SourceAccount; EFS encrypts data at rest with the customer-managed key and uses grants (kms:CreateGrant) for the encrypted file system. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/encryption-at-rest.html

AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Memory.conditions_hint: StringEquals kms:ViaService bedrock-agentcore.{region}.amazonaws.com. Memory encrypts data at rest with the customer-managed key. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/storage-encryption.html

AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway.conditions_hint: StringEquals kms:ViaService bedrock-agentcore.{region}.amazonaws.com; StringLike kms:EncryptionContext:aws:bedrock-agentcore-gateway:arn. Gateway service role encrypts metadata with the customer-managed key. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/gateway-encryption.html

AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Evaluator.conditions_hint: StringEquals aws:SourceAccount; ArnLike aws:SourceArn evaluator ARN. AgentCore service principal encrypts recommendation/evaluation data with the customer-managed key. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/recommendations-encryption.html

AWS::BedrockAgentCore::PolicyEngine.conditions_hint: StringEquals kms:ViaService bedrock-agentcore.{region}.amazonaws.com; StringLike kms:EncryptionContext:aws:bedrock-agentcore-policy:policy-engine-arn. Policy engine encrypts the engine and child resources with the customer-managed key. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/policy-encryption.html
